messages:
maria: Quick sync / scope lock proposal: finalizing launch gates for enterprise compliance (audit logs, BYOK/KMS, SOC2 evidence, retention tiers). Posting a compact risk-first checklist below; please ACK or propose changes.

ankur: ack. Couple questions: are we including Azure Key Vault and OCI KMS in MVP or leaving them to post-MVP? Also thinking about cross-region export guarantees.

maria: plan: MVP must support AWS KMS + Azure Key Vault. OCI / GCP KMS as follow-up. Cross-region read-after-write guarantees for audit writes in MVP should cover primary region only; cross-region replication is post-launch. Need to call that out.

sasha: dev constraints: evidence packaging will require deterministic manifest and signer. MVP format = gzipped tarball + manifest.json (SHA256 for each file) + detached signature. Post-MVP: signed parquet bundles and timestamping via TSA.

devon: ops must have a clear key-revocation and emergency-export runbook before Gate 1 signoff. That includes: 1) how to initiate escrow export, 2) who approves, 3) terraform scripts to spin export worker. If that runbook is missing, oncall will block.

kate (legal): retention tiers must have business justification text and deletion workflows. For SOC2 we also need immutable snapshots for quarter-end evidence. Also require legal-hold override path that prevents deletion even if TTL expires.

ankur: technical note: Search SLOs are tricker with big tenants. Proposal: SLO scoped to "hot window" (last 60 days) 95p95 < 400ms for typical queries; cold data retrieval is async export (within 24h SLA). We should document indexing strategy and sharding to meet that.

maria: ok set hot window = 60d. Add explicit statement that cold queries are best-effort with async export. That is a gate item: documentation + UI flow for customers to request archive exports.

sasha: SDK+handshake example for BYOK (MVP supporting AWS & Azure):
```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.com/v1/keys/handshake -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN' -d '{"tenant":"acme","provider":"azure","key_uri":"azurevault://https://myvault.vault.azure.net/keys/key-id"}'
```
Integration tests needed for both providers.

devon: ops-bot schedule: canary window for BYOK + evidence-packaging: 2026-06-01 00:00 UTC -> 2026-06-04 00:00 UTC. Notifications set.

ops-bot: deploy-bot: Canary scheduled: 2026-06-01T00:00Z -> 2026-06-04T00:00Z. Pager targets: eng-oncall, eng-sre, security. :white_check_mark:

maria: Proposed Gate 1 (required pre-public-launch):
- A) Search SLO & benchmark evidence for hot window (60d) documented and met (95p95 < 400ms).
- B) Per-tenant TTL controls (UI + API) + retention justification doc for each tier (30,90,365,indef).
- C) BYOK handshake + end-to-end integration tests for AWS KMS and Azure Key Vault (including rotation path).
- D) SOC2 evidence packaging: deterministic manifest, SHA256 per entry, detached signature, immutable quarter-end snapshot capability.
- E) Key revocation + emergency escrow runbook with approval flow and terraform workers.
- F) Legal-hold override workflow documented and tested.

Gate 2 (post-launch): cross-region replication, OCI/GCP KMS providers, signed parquet bundles, TSA timestamping, advanced archive search SLO improvements.

ankur: ACK on infra side if benchmarks pass. I'll post perf runs by EOD (3965009000). Also will add a short design doc on shard/index design.

sasha: ACK. I'll open PR with SDK examples and test matrix (3965009150).

devon: ACK pending runbook draft. I'll add runbook to ops-runbooks and tag this thread (3965009250). If runbook missing or incomplete I'll raise a stop.

kate (legal): ACK with one add: include metadata schema that captures chain_of_custody fields (actor, action, timestamp, request_id) and retention justification strings before launch.

maria: Action items recap: @ankur post perf bench + doc (3965009000), @sasha PR + tests (3965009150), @devon runbook draft (3965009250), @kate upload retention matrix & metadata schema (3965009300). If all ACKs and artifacts present by EOD we lock scope and schedule the canary. :rocket:

ankur: on it.

sasha: PR in flight.

devon: runbook drafted, will ping.

maria: Thanks everyone. If no objections by EOD we mark Gate 1 as required in the roadmap spreadsheet and start comms for beta tenants.
